semantic_label: key dispatch: acquire a subject when none is supplied, dispatch the key through vtable slot 0x08 and replay the 0xe18d6423 fallback when the first answer is refused
declaration: void __cdecl dispatch_key_00628450(OpaqueObject00628* subject, TargetWord key, TargetWord reserved, TargetWord context)

abi.frame: PUSH EBP / MOV EBP,ESP / SUB ESP,0x18
abi.return_contract: none; the target returns no value and EAX is not an answer

observed_body.instruction_count_source: a linear objdump of the byte extent below; no staging handoff covered this address
instruction_list: on the null path call the provider port 0x0067ddd0 and acquire through vtable slot 0x5c with the provider as the receiver
load vtable slot 0x08 and dispatch with the key, a literal zero for the reserved word and the context word
compare the answer byte against 0x01 and dispatch the 0xe18d6423 fallback key with the same zero and context when it differs
the reserved word is never forwarded; the model pushes a literal zero

mechanics: on the null path call the provider port 0x0067ddd0 and acquire through vtable slot 0x5c with the provider as the receiver

runtime_gates: the subject class is unresolved; the target reads only the opaque vtable pointer
0x0067ddd0 is a dependency-only port, so the acquire is unverified in this package
the provider is dereferenced without a null test, so a null provider is a latent fault in the original and the model keeps the same unguarded read
decompilation_defects_corrected: the decompilation forwards the reserved word to the dispatch; the assembly pushes a literal zero, so the corrected model pushes zero and the metadata records that the third argument is never used
the decompilation tests the answer as a full word; the assembly compares the low byte against one, so the model narrows to the byte
